mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_user_report ( user_id, report_date, login_times, register_status, recharge_times, recharge_amt, first_recharge_status, first_recharge_amt, placeorder_times, order_amt, order_result_amt, activate_status, user_cash_out_times, user_cash_out_amt, agent_cash_out_times, agent_cash_out_amt, receive_user_reward_times, receive_user_reward_amt, receive_agent_reward_times, receive_agent_reward_amt ) SELECT p.user_id, p.proc_date, -- 0 登录 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 0 THEN 1 END ) AS login_cnt, -- 1 注册 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 1 THEN 1 END ) AS register_cnt, -- 2 充值 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN 1 END ) AS recharge_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 2 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS recharge_amout, -- 3 首充 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN 1 END ) AS first_recharge_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 3 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS first_recharge_amout, -- 4 下单 COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.order_times END ), 0 ) AS order_times, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS order_amout, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 4 THEN p.order_result_amt END ), 0 ) AS order_result_amout, -- 5 激活 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 5 THEN 1 END ) AS activate_cnt, -- 6 用户钱包提现 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN 1 END ) AS user_withdraw_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 6 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS user_withdraw_amt, -- 7 代理钱包提现 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN 1 END ) AS agent_withdraw_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 7 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS agent_withdraw_amt, -- 8 领取用户活动奖励 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 8 THEN 1 END ) AS receive_user_reward_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 8 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS receive_user_reward_amout, -- 9 领取代理活动奖励 COUNT( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 9 THEN 1 END ) AS receive_agent_reward_cnt, COALESCE ( SUM( CASE WHEN p.proc_type = 9 THEN p.proc_value END ), 0 ) AS receive_agent_reward_amout FROM p_user_proc p WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY p.user_id, p.proc_date ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_times = login_times + VALUES(login_times), register_status = GREATEST(register_status, VALUES(register_status)), recharge_times = recharge_times + VALUES(recharge_times), recharge_amt = recharge_amt + VALUES(recharge_amt), first_recharge_status = GREATEST(first_recharge_status, VALUES(first_recharge_status)), first_recharge_amt = first_recharge_amt + VALUES(first_recharge_amt), placeorder_times = placeorder_times + VALUES(placeorder_times), order_amt = order_amt + VALUES(order_amt), order_result_amt = order_result_amt + VALUES(order_result_amt), activate_status = GREATEST(activate_status, VALUES(activate_status)), user_cash_out_times = user_cash_out_times + VALUES(user_cash_out_times), user_cash_out_amt = user_cash_out_amt + VALUES(user_cash_out_amt), agent_cash_out_times = agent_cash_out_times + VALUES(agent_cash_out_times), agent_cash_out_amt = agent_cash_out_amt + VALUES(agent_cash_out_amt), receive_user_reward_times = receive_user_reward_times + VALUES(receive_user_reward_times), receive_user_reward_amt = receive_user_reward_amt + VALUES(receive_user_reward_amt), receive_agent_reward_times = receive_agent_reward_times + VALUES(receive_agent_reward_times), receive_agent_reward_amt = receive_agent_reward_amt + VALUES(receive_agent_reward_amt)

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_pending_user (user_id,market_team_id,parent_id,vip_id,activate_status,agent_id) SELECT p.user_id, u.market_team_id, u.parent_id, u.vip_id, u.activate_status, u.agent_id FROM p_user_proc p INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} AND p.proc_type IN ( 2, 4 ) GROUP BY p.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pending_user p INNER JOIN s_wallet w ON w.user_id = p.user_id AND w.wallet_type = 0 SET p.recharge_amt = w.recharge_amt, p.order_amt = w.order_amt

UPDATE s_user u INNER JOIN t_pending_user t ON t.user_id = u.id AND t.activate_status = 0 AND t.recharge_amt >= activation_recharge_amt AND t.order_amt >= activation_order_amt SET u.activate_status = 1,u.activate_time = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p_user_proc (user_id,proc_type,proc_date,proc_time) SELECT t.user_id, 5, curdate(), NOW() FROM t_user_activate t
mapper.update: UPDATE t_pending_user u JOIN ( SELECT t.user_id, MAX( v.id ) target_vip_id FROM t_pending_user t INNER JOIN s_vip v ON v.id > t.vip_id AND t.recharge_amt >= v.upgrade_amt AND t.order_amt >= v.upgrade_order_amt GROUP BY t.user_id ) x ON x.user_id = u.user_id SET u.target_vip_id = x.target_vip_id
UPDATE s_user u INNER JOIN t_pending_user t ON t.user_id = u.id AND t.target_vip_id IS NOT NULL SET u.vip_id = t.target_vip_id, u.chg_vip_time = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p_user_proc (user_id, proc_type, proc_value, proc_date, proc_time) SELECT t.user_id, 10 proc_type, v.id, CURDATE(), NOW() FROM t_pending_user t INNER JOIN s_vip v ON v.id > t.vip_id AND t.recharge_amt >= v.upgrade_amt AND t.order_amt >= v.upgrade_order_amt
INSERT INTO t_agent_upgrade(user_id,agent_id) SELECT t.parent_id,u.agent_id FROM t_pending_user t INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = t.parent_id GROUP BY t.parent_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_agent_upgrade a INNER JOIN ( SELECT t.user_id, SUM( w.recharge_amt ) sub_user_recharge_amt, SUM( w.order_amt ) sub_user_order_amt FROM t_agent_upgrade t INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.parent_id = t.user_id INNER JOIN s_wallet w ON w.user_id = u.id AND w.wallet_type = 0 GROUP BY t.user_id ) x ON x.user_id = a.user_id SET a.sub_user_recharge_amt = x.sub_user_recharge_amt, a.sub_user_order_amt = x.sub_user_order_amt

UPDATE t_agent_upgrade au JOIN ( SELECT t.user_id, MAX( a.id ) target_agent_id FROM t_agent_upgrade t INNER JOIN s_agent a ON a.id > t.agent_id AND t.sub_user_recharge_amt >= a.upgrade_amt AND t.sub_user_order_amt >= a.upgrade_order_amt GROUP BY t.user_id ) x ON x.user_id = au.user_id SET au.target_agent_id = x.target_agent_id
UPDATE s_user u INNER JOIN t_agent_upgrade t ON t.user_id = u.id AND t.target_agent_id IS NOT NULL SET u.agent_id = t.target_agent_id, u.chg_agent_time = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO p_user_proc (user_id, proc_type, proc_value, proc_date, proc_time) SELECT t.user_id, 11 proc_type, a.id, CURDATE(), NOW() FROM t_agent_upgrade t INNER JOIN s_agent a ON a.id > t.agent_id AND t.sub_user_recharge_amt >= a.upgrade_amt AND t.sub_user_order_amt >= a.upgrade_order_amt
